<!--
Title format:  <type>: <short summary>      e.g.  fix: stop fuel duplicating on swap
An optional scope is allowed:  <type>(<scope>): <summary>   e.g.  feat(menu): add tier comparison
The "PR title" check fails until the title starts with one of the types below.
-->

**Type:** <!-- one of the types below, matching the title prefix -->

| Type | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `fix` | Fixing a bug |
| `feat` | Adding a new feature |
| `build` | Updates that affect the build system or process |
| `chore` | Changes that do not affect what the code means (whitespace, formatting, typos, comments) |
| `docs` | Documentation-only changes |
| `test` | Adding or fixing tests |
| `refactor` | A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature |
| `ci` | Changes to the CI config |
| `localize` | Translations and localization |
| `bump` | Increasing the version of a dependency |
| `revert` | Undoing a previous commit |
